easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a marine chart with a straight track line drawn across it and small pencil marks along that line? A chart, a chartlet or a photograph of one all count as yes. Answer no only if the image instead shows a bare card stating an answer with none of that around it, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.
